gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1910 reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 792.7m at 1 January 2023. Management report an overall improvement in prior year reserves for 2022 and 2021 driven by favourable claims experience in longer-tail and specialty classes; using the claims development table (triangle) as a cross-check, the net prior-year development equates to an approximate GBP 10.6m release (c.1.34% of opening gross reserves). The improvement is attributed to favourable claims development in longer-tail/specialty lines, partially offset in the period by current-year catastrophe activity (notably US convective storms and Atlantic hurricanes) which had limited landfall impact for the Syndicate. The prior year movement was inferred from the claims development table as no single explicit aggregate prior-year movement figure was published.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: The explicit aggregate prior-year reserve movement was not stated in a single note. The prior year development figure (-10.6) was calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) as a last-resort cross-check. The opening gross claims outstanding value is taken directly from the Technical Provisions table.
